acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics

Here, we apply data independent acquisition with gas phase fractionation (DIA-GPF) proteomics to investigate temporal changes in HCT 116 spheroids every two days throughout 18 days of growth, identifying 6,835 proteins across all samples.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Alkylation was performed using an excess of iodoacetamide (~40 mM) at room temperature in the dark for 30 minutes, followed by centrifugation at 13,000 g for 8 minutes.
